tools.description: Move an active alert to acknowledged. Returns the updated alert and the appended event.
tools.name: acknowledge_alert

tools.description: Cancel a running scan. The record ends as canceled, never clean.
tools.name: cancel_scan

tools.description: Clear a device's trust mark (back to default handling) (trust.set tier "none"). Returns the updated device, the appended timeline event, and the forgeability caveat.
tools.name: clear_device_mark

tools.description: One event with its full explanation: detail payload, why, context, and suggested next actions (each naming its tool).
tools.name: explain_event

tools.description: Flag a device to watch closely (trust.set tier "flagged"). Returns the updated device, the appended timeline event, and the forgeability caveat.
tools.name: flag_device

tools.description: The full record for one device: interfaces, trust history, score breakdown, counts.
tools.name: get_device

tools.description: The full policy object (scan-on-mount, quarantine, hold, thresholds, retention).
tools.name: get_policy

tools.description: A scan's state, progress, per-file verdicts, and quarantine records. Pass scanId for one scan, or deviceId for that device's scans.
tools.name: get_scan

tools.description: The daemon health picture: monitoring state, permissions, scanner, and counts. Read this before trusting any other answer.
tools.name: get_status

tools.description: Events newest first, each with a one-sentence plain-language summary.
tools.name: get_timeline

tools.description: Alerts with their triggering events, current state, why, and suggested actions.
tools.name: list_alerts

tools.description: List present and historical devices with a summary, trust tier, and score.
tools.name: list_devices

tools.description: Mute a device (trust.set tier "muted"). Returns the updated device, the appended timeline event, and the forgeability caveat.
tools.name: mute_device

tools.description: Move a quarantined file back to its original location. Requires confirm:true in the same call, because restoring bytes ClamAV flagged is deliberate. The result carries the explicit-risk sentence.
tools.name: restore_quarantine

risk.const: You are restoring a file ClamAV flagged; only do this if you are certain it is a false positive.

tools.description: Start a malware scan of a device's volume or a volume path. Returns the scanId immediately; poll get_scan or watch tail_events.
tools.name: scan_storage

tools.description: The current behavioral score with its full per-signal reasoning. The result always carries the caveat that scoring is probabilistic.
tools.name: score_device

caveat.const: Behavioral scoring is probabilistic and a patient attacker can evade it.

tools.description: Update policy with a partial object; unknown keys are rejected. The mount-hold key additionally requires confirm:true because it pauses mounts until scanned. Returns the full updated policy.
tools.name: set_policy

tools.description: Long-poll for the NEXT live event. Subscribes, then holds up to waitSeconds (default 25, max 55), returning as soon as a matching event arrives, else an empty list. Live-only and best-effort: it reports events that occur AFTER this call registers its subscription; it does NOT replay historical events from before then. Loop on it, passing the returned nextCursor back as afterCursor, to keep watching live.

afterCursor.description: Echoed back as nextCursor so you can chain live polls; it does NOT fetch past events. Tailing is live-only, so an afterCursor taken from an earlier event will not replay events that occurred before this call subscribed.

tools.name: tail_events

tools.description: Mark a device trusted (trust.set tier "trusted"). Returns the updated device, the appended timeline event, and the forgeability caveat.
tools.name: trust_device
